summary: New Stripe webhook handler: signature verification cannot be confirmed without a test-mode signing secret, which the job is not granted.

findings.problem: Handler calls stripe.Webhook.construct_event with STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET; policy grants no test-mode secret, so rejection of unsigned/replayed events cannot be exercised (risk trigger: webhook).
findings.expected_fix: Operator provides a test-mode webhook secret scoped to the sandbox, or a recorded signed fixture from the trusted evidence store.

checked_criteria: Secret scan of diff (no secret committed)
limitations: Production webhook endpoints are out of scope and were not contacted

threats.description: Forged or replayed webhook events accepted
